settings.text:
Studying nutrition changed my life.ﾠIt helped me cut through the confusion of paleo, veganism, plant-based, intermittent fasting, and more to experience lasting energy, vitality, and improved immunity.

It gave me the tools and knowledge to help heal my father, successfully getting him off six medications, losing over 50lbs, and completely recovering his life and health. Being a part of this transformation also gave me the inspiration and confidence to start Food Matters.

Now it's time to take our power back!

James Colquhoun

settings.title: Module One: Dietary Theory & Food Fundamentals
settings.text: This introductory module will lay the foundational knowledge you'll need to grasp key nutrition principles - and then apply them. We'll start by breaking down nutrition fundamentals, and explore the concept of biochemical individuality - why there are no one-size-fits-all solutions in nutrition. At the end of this module, you'll understand how to nourish your body's unique requirements and make more informed food choices.
settings.dropdown_text:
In this module you will learn:

  • How to read a nutrition label.
  • How to decode the modern food system.
  • How to avoid the harmful impacts of sugar, agricultural chemicals, and food additives.
  • The impact of modern wheat on health.
  • Which foods you should eat and which foods you should avoid.

Expert Teachers: Vani Hari, Sarah Lantz, John Robbins, Cyndi O’Meara, Dr. William Davis, Dr. Alejandro Junger, Dr. Christiane Northrup, Mike Adams & Laurentine ten Bosch

settings.title: Module Two: Nutrition in the 21st Century
settings.text: Public health is declining, but knowledge is power. In this module, we'll explore how politics, industries, and big businesses have contributed to the deteriorating health of the population.
settings.dropdown_text:
In this module you will learn:

  • How to read a nutrition label.
  • How to decode the modern food system.
  • How to avoid the harmful impacts of sugar, agricultural chemicals, and food additives.
  • The impact of modern wheat on health.
  • Which foods you should eat and which foods you should avoid.

Expert Teachers: Vani Hari, Sarah Lantz, John Robbins, Cyndi O’Meara, Dr. William Davis, Dr. Alejandro Junger, Dr. Christiane Northrup, Mike Adams & Laurentine ten Bosch

settings.title: Module Three: Understanding Nutrients & Superfoods
settings.text: Get ready to learn your macronutrients from your micronutrients, the best sources of both, and common nutrient deficiencies. At the end of this module, you'll understand how to identify the signs and symptoms of nutrient deficiencies in the body and increase your absorption of nutrients using superfoods, herbs, and natural supplements.
settings.dropdown_text:
In this module you will learn:

  • How to understand macronutrients, micronutrients, calories and energy.
  • How to manage blood glucose levels.
  • The benefits of protein.
  • The importance of hydration.
  • Which healthy fats you should eat and which fats you should avoid.

Expert Teachers: Christa Orecchio, Udo Erasmus, Elizabeth Rider, Dr. Ian Brighthope, Dr. Andrew Saul, David Wolfe, Daniel Vitalis & Susan Teton

settings.title: Module Four: The Power of Detoxification & Cleansing
settings.text: In this module, we'll explore how your environment, lifestyle, and food choices can aid the body's natural detoxification pathways or burden them.
settings.dropdown_text:
In this module you will learn:

  • How to support your body's natural detoxification system.
  • How to support the body through sickness and health.
  • How to understand the impact of environmental chemicals on your health.
  • The importance of our lymphatic system.
  • The food and herbs you can eat to support your optimal health.

Expert Teachers: Charlotte Gerson, Dr. Alejandro Junger, David Wolfe, Sarah Lantz, Dr. Sandeep Gupta, Dr. Victor Zeines & Jason Vale

settings.title: Module Five: Healing Your Gut Naturally
settings.text: This module is a deep dive into the gut microbiome, exploring the digestive system, key organs, and the gut-brain connection.
settings.dropdown_text:
In this module you will learn:

  • How to understand the digestive system and the gut microbiome.
  • How to optimize your gut health to improve leaky gut, digestive issues, and skin conditions.
  • Which foods nourish and which foods damage our gut health.
  • The impact of modern wheat, processed foods, and additives on our digestive health.
  • All about prebiotics, probiotics, fermented foods, and fiber.

Expert Teachers: Christa Orecchio, Dr. Tom O’Bryan, Sayer Ji, David Wolfe & Dr. Josh Axe

settings.title: Module Six: Decoding Your Hormones & Imbalances
settings.text: Improvements in diet, lifestyle, and sleep can start the healing process of many hormone-related conditions. At the end of this module, you'll have explored how hormone imbalances can lead to other issues, and understand how to start managing your hormones natural for better wellbeing.
settings.dropdown_text:
In this module you will learn:

  • How the endocrine system works.
  • How to avoid hormone disruptors.
  • Which foods and herbs to eat to support healthy hormones.
  • Lifestyle practices and plant remedies to use for balancing hormones.
  • How to begin healing specific-hormone related conditions, including, premenstrual syndrome (PMS), menopause, skin issues, fatigue, low libido & digestive issues.

Expert Teachers: Dr. Joseph Mercola, Vanessa Lamaro, David Wolfe, Dr. Tami Meraglia & Dr. Libby Weaver

settings.title: Module Seven: The Impact of Stress & Poor Sleep
settings.text: Less stress, more sleep. At the end of this module, you'll understand how to critically evaluate stress levels and the influence that this is having on your sleep cycle. Plus, apply practical stress reduction and sleep-promoting techniques to enable deep healing, rest, and recovery.
settings.dropdown_text:
In this module you will learn:

  • The long-term implications of chronic stress and EMF exposure.
  • How stress impacts the body and mind.
  • Practical ways to reduce stress.
  • Natural solutions for better sleep, including grounding and essential oils.
  • How to give your body rest and recovery for deep healing.

Expert Teachers: Marc David, Bruce Lipton, Joe Dispenza, Dr. Alan Christianson, Dave Asprey, Shawn Stevenson, Dr. Eric Zielinski, Clint Ober & Jason Prall

settings.title: Module Eight: Boosting Immunity & Mastering Autoimmune Disease
settings.text: Explore how the immune system functions and its connection to gut health, plus specific herbs and foods to support yourself through everything from common autoimmune conditions like rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, and Hashimoto's thyroiditis, to the common cold. At the end of this module, you'll understand how to support your immune system naturally, year-round.
settings.dropdown_text:
In this module you will learn:

  • How the immune system & autoimmune conditions work.
  • The links between food intolerances, allergies, hormones, and gut inflammation.
  • The best foods to eat for when sick.
  • How to use aromatherapy to reduce inflammation and boost immunity.
  • How to build your own immune-boosting medicine cabinet.

Expert Teachers: Dr. Amina Eastham-Hillier, Dr. Tom O’Bryan, JJ Virgin & Dr. Eric Zielinski

settings.title: Module Nine: Understanding Chronic Disease & Cancer
settings.text: Discover how cancer manifests in the body and some of the societal issues leading to a rise in this and other chronic diseases. At the end of this module, you'll understand why our current treatment protocols aren't working and the natural alternatives that have proven to be just as effective.
settings.dropdown_text:
In this module you will learn:

  • The link between chronic disease and inflammation.
  • The weaknesses in modern medical treatments for cancer and chronic disease.
  • Alternative treatment pathways for chronic disease and cancer.
  • The easily accessible foods to eat to fight cancer.
  • Important strategies on how to support loved ones through treatment.

Expert Teachers: Dr. Andrew Saul, Charlotte Gerson, Cyrus Khambatta, Dr. Dan Rogers, Liana Werner-Gray, Udo Erasmus & Jon Gabriel

settings.title: Module Ten: Using Plants as Medicine
settings.text: From wholefoods and herbs to fungi and essential oils, plants can help our bodies thrive, heal, and perform at their peak. At the end of this module, you'll understand how to use nature to regain your health.
settings.dropdown_text:
In this module you will learn:

  • The power of plants, and how to use herbs, mushrooms & adaptogens to thrive.
  • How to add the correct foods and herbal remedies to treatment programs.
  • The best foods to eat to naturally manage mood and anxiety.
  • The best essential oils for healing.
  • Longevity techniques from the Blue Zones.

Expert Teachers: Daniel Vitalis, Ocean Robbins, Liana Werner-Gray, Dave Asprey, Nick Polizzi, Dr. Eric Zielinski, Jason Wrobel, Ryland Engelhart, Kim Morrison & Jason Prall

settings.title: We're committed to helping you help yourself.
settings.subheading: We believe that your body is worthy of good care and that no one is more suitably qualified to care for it than yourself.

settings.title: How long will it take to complete the course?
settings.dropdown_text: The course is made up of ten modules and we recommend dedicating approximately 5 hours to completing each module, making the course easy to complete in 12 weeks. Because the course is 100% online and accessible 24/7 with no lecture commitments, you can start when you're ready, and complete it around your own schedule or downtime after work.

settings.title: Is the course accredited?
settings.dropdown_text: The Food Matters Nutrition Certification Course is an approved health & wellness coach training program for continuing education of National Board Certified Health and Wellness Coaches (NBC-HWCs). Qualifying graduates can receive 32 CE/CPD credits through NBHWC. It is recognized by the International Approval and Registration Centre (IARC), and is an approved training provider with the International Institute for Complementary Therapists (IICT). This means our graduates qualify for membership and insurance through IICT under the Nutrition Consultant modality.

settings.title: What are continuing education credits?
settings.dropdown_text: Health coaches belonging to the National Board for Health & Wellness Coaching (NBHWC) are encouraged to review, advance, and enhance professional knowledge, practice, and skills by gaining Continuing Education Credits (CE credits) from third-party programs and courses. This means that if you are a health coach under the NBHWC you will be eligible to receive CE credits upon completion of the Food Matters Nutrition Certification Course [CEA-000477-1].

settings.title: What diet philosophy is taught inside the course?
settings.dropdown_text:
The content within this course doesn't adhere to any one specific diet or way of eating, and this is because we believe in bio-individuality and that there is no one-size-fits-all approach when it comes to nutrition and health. The course emphasizes consuming a primarily plant-based diet because there is strong evidence for the benefits of consuming a large variety of plant-based foods. There is content discussing how to ethically include quality animal products in your diet for those who choose to (or for those who find themselves coaching clients who choose to).

Ultimately we focus on giving students a deep understanding of the foundations required for optimal health and nutrition and the science behind food, nutrition, and many of the key systems in the body. We believe that once you have this foundational knowledge, it's much easier to interpret and implement information on health and nutrition!

settings.title: Can I study at my own pace?
settings.dropdown_text: Yes. The Food Matters Nutrition Certification Course is designed to be completed at your own pace, from the comfort of your own home. You have lifetime access to the course, so you can jump into each lesson when you're ready.

settings.title: What is a Food Matters Certified Coach?
settings.dropdown_text: A Food Matters Certified Coach is a consultant who coaches in nutrition and has a deep knowledge of basic nutrition principles and the skills required to provide nutrition guidance to their clients. Embodying core principles of holistic nutrition and natural medicine using a food as medicine approach to educate and guide their clients (and themselves) to help them achieve their nutrition and health goals and reach optimal health.

settings.title: What if I don't like the course?
settings.dropdown_text: Our priority is the happiness of our customers, so if you aren't 100% satisfied with the course, you can email us for a full refund within 14 days. We have a money-back guarantee, no questions asked.

settings.title: Will I have access to support?
settings.dropdown_text: Yes! You'll be supported by our incredible Student Support Team and Certification Course coordinator (a qualified nutritionist) via live chat, email, or Whatsapp. You'll also have access to a thriving online student community where you'll be supported by peers from around the world who are working through the course with you. If you would like extra support, you can also join one of our guided intakes where you will study alongside a group of peers and our student advisor.

settings.title: How long do I have access to the course?
settings.dropdown_text: You have lifetime access to the course including all future course updates meaning you can start when you're ready and complete it around your own schedule.

settings.title: Will I be able to take a test and earn a certificate after completing this course?
settings.dropdown_text: Yes. To earn the Food Matters Certified Coach Certificate, you must complete each lesson and pass each module quiz by gaining 80% or higher. You can retake each quiz more than once.

settings.title: What will the Food Matters Nutrition Certification Course allow me to do in my business?
settings.dropdown_text:
The Food Matters Nutrition Certification Course equips students with the knowledge and tools needed to take control of their health and an avenue to launch a career in the wellness space. There are endless options when it comes to using your Certificate and the Bonus Business Course, which will help give you some ideas around how you can use the certification in your career.

Generally, Coaches in Nutrition do not require a state license to practice and can be certified through private credentialing bodies such as Food Matters. However, it is recommended that you check with licensing authorities in your country and locality before offering any service to the public. The Food Matters Nutrition Certification Course is designed to provide in-depth knowledge and understanding of nutrition, natural healing, and the mind-body connection. You will earn a certificate of completion when graduating our program, confirming that you have completed our program. Our program does not make you a state-registered dietician or licensed nutritionist. To determine applicable licensing requirements, you will need to check with state and local agencies where you conduct your business and where your clients reside.

settings.title: What does lifetime access to the course include?
settings.dropdown_text: Lifetime access to the course means that you will always be able to access your account and the course. Each year, we add in new and exciting lessons and bonuses, which you will also have access to!
